name: GOV.UK
summary: The UK government's GOV.UK site as data: the Content API returns any www.gov.uk page as JSON, and the Search API searches, filters and aggregates all GOV.UK content.
notes: Free and keyless; no onboarding or agreement.
Content API: at most 10 requests per second per client; above that requests queue and may time out.
The Content API covers HTML pages on www.gov.uk only (not other gov.uk subdomains, not attachments or images, not dynamic pages such as search results) and is marked beta.

endpoints.name: Search GOV.UK content
endpoints.summary: Documents on GOV.UK matching a query and filters, with title, description, link and other chosen fields.

count.description: Results to return: default 10, maximum 1500; 0 returns only aggregates.

start.description: 0-based offset into the results, for paging.

order.description: Field to sort on, '-' prefix for descending (e.g. -public_timestamp). Default: relevance with q, most viewed in 14 days without.

fields.description: Fields to return instead of the default set, e.g. title, description, link.

filter_organisations.description: Only documents tagged to any of these organisation slugs.

reject_organisations.description: Exclude documents tagged to these organisation slugs.

filter_format.description: Only documents of this format, e.g. transaction, person.

filter_content_store_document_type.description: Only documents of this content store document type.

filter_public_timestamp.description: Date range on publication time: 'from:<date>', 'to:<date>' or both comma-separated; ISO dates, UTC, inclusive.

aggregate_organisations.description: Group matches by organisation: a limit, then optional comma-separated options (scope:, order:, examples:, example_scope:, example_fields:).

notes: Unknown parameters or invalid values return HTTP 422.

Any field can be filtered with filter_<field> or excluded with reject_<field>; filter_any_/filter_all_ variants exist for multivalued fields. Only the common ones are named here; others need a raw call.
A start past the end returns no results and no error.

endpoints.name: Get a GOV.UK page as JSON
endpoints.summary: The structured content and metadata of one www.gov.uk page, by its path.

page_path.description: The page's path on www.gov.uk without the leading slash, as one segment (e.g. take-pet-abroad for https://www.gov.uk/take-pet-abroad).

notes: The path value is URL-encoded as a single segment, so a nested page path (with slashes) needs a raw call to /api/content/<path>.
Some items are placeholders or redirects to a catch-all item.
